visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The visual frame consists of a digital infographic superimposed on a textured background photo of red, inflamed skin. The center features five circular icons illustrating common rosacea triggers: a thermometer for dry environments, a microscopic parasite, a UV sun icon, a glass of red wine, and a bowl of spicy noodles. Each icon is accompanied by textual labels. At the bottom, three skincare product illustrations—a blue cleanser bottle, a dropper bottle, and a white cream jar—are presented as recommended solutions under a secondary heading asking how to soothe the skin condition. (2) The scene cuts to a high-contrast white background featuring a central professional logo for 'DRX Series Skincare'. Glowing, semi-transparent white lines and light streaks arc diagonally across the frame from bottom-left to top-right, creating a clean, clinical, and high-end aesthetic. The logo and text remain stationary in the center throughout this phase.
